easyPrerequisites: You have another instant or sorcery card in your graveyard or own an exiled card that has flashback.
description:
Cast Seething Song by paying {2}{R}.
Eye of the Storm triggers, exiling Seething Song and causing you to cast a copy of it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the Seething Song copy, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Cast Sorceress's Schemes either from your hand by paying {3}{R} or from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {4}{R}.
Eye of the Storm triggers, exiling Sorceress's Schemes and causing you to cast a copy of it and Seething Song without paying their mana costs.
Resolve the copy of Sorceress's Schemes, returning the original Sorceress's Schemes from exile to your hand and adding {R}.
Resolve the copy of Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.
